answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a formal notation where applicable, precise language register, it stays short. The harbor is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the cedar. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution. Reaching the ripple of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
